title: The 1 Question That Ruins Most Interviews, The Tell Me About Yourself Question
description:
You're Losing Jobs in the First 90 Seconds | How to Answer "Tell Me About Yourself"

Most interviews are won or lost in the first 90 seconds, not in the tough questions 20 minutes in. Interviewers form an impression within the first 30 to 60 seconds, and on phone and video interviews around 80% of that impression is built on tonality alone. This video breaks down the exact 3-part structure I use with every candidate to answer "tell me about yourself" without sounding like every other applicant.

If you keep getting rejected from interviews and the feedback is "nice, but didn't stand out", this is almost always the reason, and it is fixable. I walk through the Identity-Value-Motivation frame, the 3 mistakes that kill most opening answers, and the 1 delivery fix that matters more than the script itself.

What you'll learn in this video:
- The 3-part Identity-Value-Motivation structure to answer "tell me about yourself" in 90 seconds
- What interviewers are actually listening for in the first 60 seconds (the warmth test)
- The 3 mistakes that get candidates written off before the second question
- The tonality and delivery fix that decides phone and video interviews
- The 90-second practice drill to run before every interview round
